title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards — Tax Service Cap by Card Spend at Marlowe & Finch (Merchandise Purchases)
content:
**Cap rule.** On a refund of sales tax charged on the part a Finch Note paid on a Merchandise Purchases unit, a customer whose Marlowe & Finch purchases charged to a Marlowe & Finch card in the twelve calendar months before the request date (purchases whose transaction date falls less than twelve whole months before it) reach the upper tax card-spend threshold of $1500.00 has the upper tax service cap of $1.00; one whose such purchases reach the middle tax card-spend threshold of $500.00 but not the upper has the middle tax service cap of $0.50. A customer whose such purchases total less than $500.00 is outside this rule.

The purchases are the purchase transactions at Marlowe & Finch on the customer's Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards accounts.

| Card purchases at Marlowe & Finch, past twelve months (hypothetical) | Tax service cap |
|---|---|
| $1500.00 | $1.00 |
| $1499.99 | $0.50 |
| $500.00 | $0.50 |
| $499.99 | outside this rule |
